text.tspan: The boundaries and names shown and the designations used on this map do not imply official
endorsement or acceptance by the United Nations. Dotted line represents approximately the
Line of Control in Jammu and Kashmir agreed upon by India and Pakistan. The final status of
Jammu and Kashmir has not yet been agreed upon by the parties.
Map created on DD Mmm YYYY.
Map Sources: UNCS, ESRI, The Times Altlas of the World.
